wholePhysicalScope: Named OpenStreetMap upper citadel outline, Betta27’s original 2009 photograph, and written facts from Iran’s national tourism portal.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the eroded mound, upper ramparts, tapering tower and raised keep. Near levels add adobe bands and wall texture geometry.
limitations: The model depicts the photographed upper adobe citadel as it survived in 2009, within the named mapped polygon. The wider archaeological precinct is outside this asset.
The placement uses the original terrain field. The mound section, wall and tower heights, and exact positions of structures within the mapped outline are visual estimates.
The model reproduces the visible tower bands, keep massing and curtain damage. Unsighted wall faces and individual openings are approximate, and the exterior asset omits interior remains.
